"""Hand-computed scenarios, verified against the protocol prose directly."""
import json, subprocess, sys

def run(request):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/cli.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(request).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[-2000:]
    return json.loads(p.stdout)['runs'][0]

fails = 0

# --- scenario 1: staged dispatch, rejection, refill-then-pop, cyclic visits
s1 = {'banks': 2, 'load_balancers': 1, 'fifo_bytes': 10, 'pifo_bytes': 10,
      'refill_batch': 2, 'sample_period': 100, 'borders': [0, 5, 20],
      'policy': {'kind': 'sff'},
      'events': [['enqueue', 1, 0, 6, 3],     # rank 3  -> r0, C=[0,0] -> bank0 accept
                 ['enqueue', 2, 0, 6, 10],    # rank 10 -> r1, C=[1,0] -> bank1 accept
                 ['enqueue', 3, 0, 6, 1],     # rank 1  -> r0, C=[1,0] -> bank1, 6+6>10 reject
                 ['dequeue', 3],
                 ['inspect', 1], ['inspect', 3], ['cancel', 3], ['cancel', 1]]}
r1 = run({'runs': [s1]})
want_log = [
    [0, 'enqueue', 1, 3, 0, 0, 0, True],
    [1, 'enqueue', 2, 10, 0, 1, 1, True],
    [2, 'enqueue', 3, 1, 0, 0, 1, False],
    [3, 'dequeue', 0, 0, 1, 3, 0, 0, []],
    [3, 'dequeue', 1, 1, 2, 10, 0, 0, []],
    [3, 'dequeue', 2, 0, None, None, 0, 0, []],
    [4, 'inspect', 1, None],
    [5, 'inspect', 3, None],
    [6, 'cancel', 3, None, None, None],
    [7, 'cancel', 1, None, None, None],
]
if r1['log'] != want_log:
    fails += 1
    print('scenario 1 log mismatch'); print(' got ', json.dumps(r1['log'])); print(' want', json.dumps(want_log))
want_state = {'tick': 3, 'load_balancer': 0, 'service_bank': 1, 'sample_progress': 2,
              'borders': [0, 5, 20],
              'counters': [[[1, 1], [0, 1]]], 'history': [0, 0],
              'policy': {'kind': 'sff'},
              'queues': [{'fifo': [], 'pifo': [], 'fifo_bytes': 0, 'pifo_bytes': 0},
                         {'fifo': [], 'pifo': [], 'fifo_bytes': 0, 'pifo_bytes': 0}],
              'lags': []}
if r1['state'] != want_state:
    fails += 1
    print('scenario 1 state mismatch'); print(' got ', json.dumps(r1['state'])); print(' want', json.dumps(want_state))

# --- scenario 2: refill pushout in descending order + a fully evicted refill
s2 = {'banks': 1, 'load_balancers': 1, 'fifo_bytes': 100, 'pifo_bytes': 10,
      'refill_batch': 3, 'sample_period': 100, 'borders': [0, 50, 200],
      'policy': {'kind': 'sff'},
      'events': [['enqueue', 10, 0, 6, 40],   # rank 40 -> r0
                 ['enqueue', 11, 0, 6, 150],  # rank 150 -> r1
                 ['enqueue', 12, 0, 6, 5],    # rank 5 -> r0
                 ['enqueue', 13, 0, 30, 7],   # 30 bytes > pifo_bytes 10
                 ['dequeue', 1],              # empty pifo: refill moves 10,11,12 (18B) -> keep 12,10 (12B>10) keep 12 only? check below
                 ['dequeue', 1],
                 ['dequeue', 1],
                 ['dequeue', 1],
                 ['dequeue', 1]]}
r2 = run({'runs': [s2]})
# Event 4: candidates by (rank,ord): 12(5),10(40),11(150); prefix bytes 6,12,18 -> keep {12} (6B);
# evict descending: 11 then 10.  Served head = 12, rank_error 0, lag 0.
# Event 5: pifo empty, fifo has 13 -> transfer 13 (30B) -> prefix keep nothing -> evict 13 -> idle.
# Events 6..8: fifo empty -> idle.
want_log2 = [
    [0, 'enqueue', 10, 40, 0, 0, 0, True],
    [1, 'enqueue', 11, 150, 0, 1, 0, True],
    [2, 'enqueue', 12, 5, 0, 0, 0, True],
    [3, 'enqueue', 13, 7, 0, 0, 0, True],
    [4, 'dequeue', 0, 0, 12, 5, 0, 0, [11, 10]],
    [5, 'dequeue', 1, 0, None, None, 0, 0, [13]],
    [6, 'dequeue', 2, 0, None, None, 0, 0, []],
    [7, 'dequeue', 3, 0, None, None, 0, 0, []],
    [8, 'dequeue', 4, 0, None, None, 0, 0, []],
]
if r2['log'] != want_log2:
    fails += 1
    print('scenario 2 log mismatch'); print(' got ', json.dumps(r2['log'])); print(' want', json.dumps(want_log2))

# --- scenario 3: lag accounting + rank_error across banks and stages
s3 = {'banks': 2, 'load_balancers': 1, 'fifo_bytes': 1000, 'pifo_bytes': 1000,
      'refill_batch': 1, 'sample_period': 100, 'borders': [0, 10, 100],
      'policy': {'kind': 'sff'},
      'events': [['enqueue', 1, 0, 10, 1],    # rank1  -> r0, bank0
                 ['enqueue', 2, 0, 10, 20],   # rank20 -> r1, bank1 (stagger)
                 ['enqueue', 3, 0, 10, 2],    # rank2  -> r0, bank1 (C[0][0]=1 after pkt1)
                 ['dequeue', 2],              # bank0 serves pkt1 (rank1): others live rank<1? none
                 ['inspect', 2], ['inspect', 3],
                 ['dequeue', 2]]}             # bank1 serves pkt3 (rank2), then bank0 serves nothing
r3 = run({'runs': [s3]})
print('scenario 3 log:')
for row in r3['log']:
    print('  ', json.dumps(row))
print('  state queues/lags:', json.dumps(r3['state']['queues']), json.dumps(r3['state']['lags']))
print('hand-checked failures:', fails)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
